rate_schedule: A Residential (Bill Codes 1,11; delivery charge only)
note: LPSC-filed DEMCO tariff, Rate A pages effective 04/01/2024 (Louisiana). Delivery Charge only: the monthly Wholesale Power Charge (WPC, per-kWh pass-through of wholesale cost, filed monthly with LPSC, not stated in tariff) is added to every bill and is NOT included; energy price here is therefore not all-in. Also excludes tax adjustment and franchise/storm riders. Three-phase adds $4.65 to the grid access charge. Experimental residential TOU schedules RTU/RTUAE exist (on-peak/shoulder kWh capped per month, see log) and are not coded. Minimum charge $12.00 (grid access); $25.00 minimum for a service period.
